**5. Your Facebook security code (suspicious sender)**
- From: security-facebook-com@gmail.com — 2024-04-12 13:26
- "Click on this link to reset your password: https://www.facebook.com/reset-password"

**6. We organize the best events! Weddings, birthday party, family reunions, and more!**
- From: info@best-event-organizers.com — 2024-04-12 23:54
- Marketing email with a link to their website.

None of these have attachments, CC, or BCC.

⚠️ A word of caution: email #5 comes from a gmail.com address pretending to be Facebook, which is a clear phishing red flag, and email #1 is an unsolicited password-reset request — I'd avoid clicking any links in either unless you can verify them independently. Emails #3 and #6 are marketing/promotional. Let me know if you'd like me to delete any of these, search for more, or take another action.
